notes: §1985:XIV.3.6.3 SR4: the mnemonic-name is identified with an implementor feature and "The mnemonic-name is defined in the SPECIAL-NAMES paragraph". CommunicationBinder#ScreenSendAdvancing takes the mnemonic arm when SPECIAL-NAMES declares the word and refuses (COBOL6171) a name whose system name is not a feature-name or that is followed by LINE/LINES; an undeclared name is COBOL1639. Witness refuses an undefined name. Probes at --std 85: (d) C01 IS TOP-PAGE and CSP IS NOSPACE accepted and ran (00); (b) TOP-PAGE LINES, a switch mnemonic, CONSOLE IS CRT refused COBOL6171; an alphabet-name, a condition-name, the bare feature-name C01 and an undefined word refused COBOL1639; a symbolic-character refused COBOL6171; mnemonic followed by PAGE refused COBOL2269. The 2002 wording of the message is PB5343 (open, misleads-diagnosis only).
